title: Add shared automated coverage for metadata, filter logic, and list view structure
description: Add and update automated tests covering the new CookbookCore helpers, filter predicate semantics, and Recipes list view structure for the filter button, badge, and sheet presentation.
acceptance_criteria: `Packages/CookbookCore/Tests/CookbookCoreTests/MetadataTests.swift` covers recognized time formats, failure cases, normalized tags, and preservation of raw tags.
`CookbookAppTests/RecipesActiveFiltersTests.swift` covers tag OR semantics, max-time boundary behavior, missing metadata exclusion, and AND composition across axes.
`CookbookAppTests/RecipesListViewTests.swift` covers broadened search behavior plus view-structure assertions for filter button presence, badge count, and sheet presentation.
